subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a documented inbound-media opt-out that prevents file/audio/video/post resources from being downloaded and forwarded as agent media context?
rationale: Current main has no supported `ignoreFileContent` key, and adding one is a new config/default surface with user-visible context and media behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Add a narrow Feishu opt-out
options.body: Introduce a documented Feishu plugin setting that defaults to current download behavior but, when disabled, emits only safe placeholders/filenames and no media paths.

options.title: Use existing media limits only
options.body: Reject the new setting and document that Feishu currently supports `mediaMaxMb` plus placeholders, not a full attachment-ingestion disable switch.

options.title: Design a shared channel policy
options.body: Defer the fix until a cross-channel inbound media/context policy can cover Feishu and other media-capable channels consistently.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow Feishu opt-out
recommendation.body: Introduce a documented Feishu plugin setting that defaults to current download behavior but, when disabled, emits only safe placeholders/filenames and no media paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Feishu media/config implementation in this checkout blames to Vincent Koc-authored commits, while package metadata also points to `m1heng` for Feishu-specific review.
